# Switch NX2 - read when the Lichii GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# [RX 9070 XT tune] leave unset: running ahead can cause flicker / wrong geometry, and the
# stock "=2" actually means "wait for every frame" (only "1" means ahead).
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=1

# --- sharkiix 3.1: shader parts (VK_EXT_graphics_pipeline_library) ---
# On by default with AMD's Windows driver: each shader is compiled in reusable parts and linked
# almost instantly, so far fewer freezes; an optimized version replaces it in the background
# after a few seconds. 0 turns it off; 1 turns it on with other drivers (untested there).
#EDEN_NX2_GPL=0
# 0 keeps the fast link only (no background optimized version; some effects then show dotted edges).
#EDEN_NX2_GPL_OPTIMIZE=0
# Shader timing log for bug reports (written to the emulator log).
#EDEN_NX2_COMPILE_TRACE=1

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# =====================================================================
# RX 9070 XT + Ryzen 5 7600X tune for sharkiix 3.1.1 (9070xt patch build)
# =====================================================================
# --- Shaders: build everything at boot ---
# By default 3.1.1 only rebuilds the pipelines you used recently. =1 builds EVERY pipeline the
# cache has ever recorded at boot (boot takes longer, then no compile hitches in any area you
# have visited before). With 3.1's shader parts (GPL) on your RX 9070 XT this boot is quick.
EDEN_NX2_PRELOAD_ALL_PIPELINES=1
# Pipelines the boot skips are built in the background instead of mid-frame.
# 3 = a quarter of the 7600X's 12 threads; the rest stay for the game and GPU thread.
EDEN_NX2_BACKGROUND_PIPELINES=1
EDEN_NX2_BACKGROUND_PIPELINE_THREADS=3

# --- Textures ---
# This build keeps up to 3/4 of VRAM for textures on 12 GB+ cards by itself (the 5 GiB cap made
# Ocarina's village delete/reload textures every ~20 s). Manual override, if ever needed:
#EDEN_NX2_TC_EXPECTED_MIB=10240
#EDEN_NX2_TC_CRITICAL_MIB=11264

# --- Image stability ---
# FSR sharpening on top of the temporal upscale makes grass/leaves/edges shimmer.
# Too soft? use e.g. EDEN_NX2_TEMPORAL_SHARPEN=1.2 instead of off.
EDEN_NX2_TEMPORAL_SHARPEN=off

# =====================================================================
# 9070xt patch build - frame-time spike fixes (new switches, defaults shown)
# =====================================================================
# Native (Switch 2) draws whose pipeline is still compiling: wait at most a short per-frame
# budget for it, then skip that draw for this frame instead of freezing for the whole compile
# (the 40-100 ms spikes on new effects/areas). Draws that write buffers/images the game may read
# back are never skipped. Needs "asynchronous shader compilation" ON in Graphics > Advanced.
# A new effect may appear a frame or two late the first time; 0 = old behaviour (freeze).
#EDEN_NX2_NATIVE_ASYNC=1
# Total time per frame native draws may wait for compiling pipelines (microseconds).
# Lower = fewer spikes but more first-time pop-in; higher = the opposite.
#EDEN_NX2_NATIVE_ASYNC_BUDGET_US=3000
# Threads that build those pipelines first, ahead of the background queue (1-8).
#EDEN_NX2_URGENT_PIPELINE_THREADS=2
# Frames a pipeline may go unused before it is destroyed (was 36000 = 10 min: coming back to an
# area after 10 minutes rebuilt everything mid-game). Default 216000 = 1 h; 0 = never.
#EDEN_NX2_EVICT_PIPELINE_FRAMES=216000
